welcome.dismiss: Accessible label of the button that closes the welcome panel.
welcome.commandTitle: Name of the command in the command palette that shows the welcome panel again.
welcome.importHint: Keep the tool names and file formats as they are.
welcome.folderHint: A folder of request files, kept in the same place as the code. "git" is the version control tool.
welcome.collectionTitle: Creates a folder in the sidebar to group requests.
welcome.curlHint: The address bar is the URL field at the top of a request.
welcome.sampleRequestName: Name of the example request that is created from the welcome panel. It becomes saved data, so it is translated when created.
